properties.name: Name
properties.defaultValue: "" (the designer assigns names such as button1)
properties.description: Identifier used to refer to the control in code and to find it with Controls.Find.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Caption or content text. Its meaning depends on the control: a button caption, label text, tab title, window title.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Background color of the control.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Color used to draw the control's text.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: When false the control is grayed out and ignores mouse and keyboard input.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Whether the control is shown. A hidden control keeps its state but is not drawn and cannot be focused.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Width and height of the control in pixels.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Position of the control's top-left corner relative to its container.

properties.name: Font
properties.defaultValue: Inherited from the parent (the form's default UI font)
properties.description: Typeface, size and style of the text.

properties.name: Dock
properties.description: Attaches the control to an edge of its container (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) or fills it (Fill), resizing automatically.

properties.name: Anchor
properties.description: Keeps the control at a fixed distance from the chosen container edges when the container is resized.

properties.name: Margin
properties.description: Space the control asks for around its outside. Layout panels such as FlowLayoutPanel respect it.

properties.name: Padding
properties.description: Space between the control's edge and its content or child controls.

properties.name: TabIndex
properties.defaultValue: Order in which the control was added
properties.description: Position of the control in the Tab-key order. Lower numbers receive focus first.

properties.name: TabStop
properties.defaultValue: true for interactive controls, false for Label, Panel and GroupBox
properties.description: Whether the Tab key can move focus to the control.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: A free slot for attaching any object (an ID, a record, a string) to the control.

properties.name: Controls
properties.description: The child controls hosted by this control. Use Add to put a control inside it.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Identifier used to refer to the item in code.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Caption shown on the item.

properties.name: Image
properties.description: Icon displayed on the item.

properties.name: DisplayStyle
properties.defaultValue: Depends on the item (Image for ToolStripButton, ImageAndText for ToolStripLabel)
properties.description: Chooses whether the item shows only text, only its image, both, or nothing.

properties.name: ToolTipText
properties.defaultValue: "" (the Text is shown when AutoToolTip is true)
properties.description: Text of the pop-up that appears when the pointer rests on the item.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: When false the item is grayed out and cannot be clicked.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Whether the item is shown on the strip.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Background color of the item.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Color of the item's text.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Typeface, size and style of the item's text.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Places the item at the left or right end of the strip.

properties.name: Margin
properties.description: Space around the item on the strip.

properties.name: Padding
properties.description: Space between the item's edge and its content.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: A free slot for attaching any object to the item.
